200.description: Measured usage buckets and complete-query totals.

schema.description: Measured spend observed in one pinned stored snapshot, not live counters, certified export completeness, verified absent usage or a final invoice. Source freshness and historical coverage are unknown when unsupported. Legacy rows without a unit use the app's current-plan fallback frozen at read selection; this is denomination inference, not certified historical denomination.

target.description: Scope measured for this query, derived from its user_id and agent_id filters: ORGANIZATION, USER with canonical user_id and known email, or AGENT.

x-enumDescriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-enumDescriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-enumDescriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-enumDescriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.ORGANIZATION: Shared limit across the organization for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_USER: Default per-user limit for the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEFAULT_AGENT: Default aggregate limit applied to agents without an agent-specific limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.USER: Limit for one user, identified by canonical user ID or email, and the selected spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.AGENT: Aggregate limit for one canonical agent ID, independent of spend client.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.IDP_GROUP: Response-only source of an inherited per-user IdP-group limit.
x-speakeasy-enum-descriptions.DEPARTMENT: Response-only source of an inherited per-user department limit.

client_id.description: Opaque, case-sensitive spend-client ID, such as glean or an external gateway spend-client ID. Case and leading or trailing padding are preserved exactly; this is not inferred from the authenticating OAuth application, prefixed, or normalized. Empty and whitespace-only IDs (including Unicode whitespace), synthetic UI aggregation IDs, and control characters are invalid. Unknown IDs are valid and can have no applicable configured policies. Required for ORGANIZATION, DEFAULT_USER, and USER configurations; forbidden for configured aggregate DEFAULT_AGENT and AGENT policies. Evaluation always requires a concrete client, including for agents. The reserved * client is valid only for the Phase 1 DEFAULT_USER actions-only premium policy, not a cross-client budget or evaluation client. Omission never selects Glean or acts as a wildcard.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; valid only when type is USER. A USER target requires user_id, email, or both.

email.description: Email address of the user, including a known alias email; valid only when type is USER. Matching is case-insensitive and resolves to the canonical user_id. When user_id is also supplied, both must identify the same user. Email is never part of the stored limit key. Responses include the user's directory email when one is available.

agent_id.description: Canonical agent ID; required only when type is AGENT.

target.title: PlatformUsageTarget

results.description: Requested page of observed buckets, at most page_size.

items.description: One observed period and grouped-dimension combination; empty buckets are omitted.

period.description: Clipped bucket interval; omitted for NONE.

start.description: Inclusive UTC midnight boundary, no earlier than midnight of the UTC day that contains the request time minus 90 days.

end.description: Exclusive UTC midnight boundary, strictly after start.

allOf.description: Filter results to those last updated within this range.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: Exclusive upper bound in ISO 8601 format.

allOf.title: PlatformTimeRange

period.title: PlatformUsageSearchTimeRange

product.description: Server-owned product taxonomy: ASSISTANT (including LLM_CALL), AGENT, DESKTOP_APP (from GLEAN_DESKTOP_APP), API, MCP, AI_GATEWAY (from LLM_GATEWAY), or OTHER for unknown nonempty event types. Values can be added.

feature.description: Server-owned feature taxonomy: ARTIFACT_AUDIO, ASSISTANT, DEEP_RESEARCH, DICTATION, ENGRAM_MEMORY, GLEAN_CODE, GLEAN_IN_SLACK, GLEAN_IN_TEAMS, IMAGE_GENERATION, INDEPENDENT_AGENT_MEMORY, MEETING_NOTES (from AUDIO_TRANSCRIPTION), PRESENTATION_GENERATION, PRISM_PAID, REALTIME_VOICE (from VOICE_TRANSCRIPTION), SKILL_SCAN, API, SEARCH, or OTHER for unknown nonempty subtypes. API uses the recorded entity when subtype is absent. Values can be added.

client_id.description: Recorded spend client ID. Usage with no client and Glean Desktop gateway usage are glean.

user_id.description: Canonical user ID; admin route only.

used_by_unit.description: Observed spend units only, ordered USD then CREDITS; never combined or converted.

items.description: Accrued usage in one unit, without combining or converting units.

used.description: Nonnegative decimal usage with at most six fractional digits.

items.title: PlatformUsageUsedValue

event_count.description: Raw billing events across both units; present only when requested.

items.title: PlatformUsageSearchBucket

totals.description: Totals over all observed stored rows matching this query across every page; USD then CREDITS, observed units only.

items.description: Accrued usage in one unit, without combining or converting units.

used.description: Nonnegative decimal usage with at most six fractional digits.

items.title: PlatformUsageUsedValue

total_count.description: Bucket count across every page; present only with TOTAL_COUNT.

start.description: Inclusive UTC midnight boundary, no earlier than midnight of the UTC day that contains the request time minus 90 days.

end.description: Exclusive UTC midnight boundary, strictly after start.

allOf.description: Filter results to those last updated within this range.

start.description: Inclusive lower bound in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: Exclusive upper bound in ISO 8601 format.

allOf.title: PlatformTimeRange

data_updated_at.description: Last completed source refresh when supported, otherwise null; read selection time is not source freshness.

earliest_available_at.description: Earliest historical coverage when supported for this scope, otherwise null; an empty result does not verify absent usage.

labels.description: With DISPLAY_NAMES, labels for grouped IDs on this page only, hydrated outside the shared measured-data cache.

additionalProperties.description: Display name of a product or feature value.

additionalProperties.description: Display name of a product or feature value.

display_name.description: Current application name; Glean for glean.

additionalProperties.description: Current metadata of an agent the caller can read.

additionalProperties.description: Current user metadata from the People directory.

email.description: User email, when permitted and known.

has_more.description: Whether another page exists in the pinned snapshot.

next_cursor.description: Opaque continuation cursor, or null when has_more is false.
